headings.h1: Prose for articles and rendered MDX

intro: Give rendered content a consistent rhythm while allowing embedded components to keep their own styles. Prose styles markup; it does not parse Markdown or inject HTML.
useCases: Documentation, article content and product details.

faqs.question: Does this require another package?
faqs.answer: No. Import from the existing ui/typography entry or vendor the typography family. No animation dependency is required.

sections.heading: Composition and API
sections.body: Selectors have zero specificity so utility classes can override them. data-prose="ignore" opts out of descendant styling; inherited container fonts/colors still apply. Wrap wide tables in an overflow-x-auto container.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body: Preserve native HTML semantics and meaningful link names. Keep headings aligned with the document outline, and provide alternate text for images.
